articles.title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
articles.description: Victoria Fuller tells the BBC the force's resources need a rethink, speaking after the A66 crash in Middlesbrough which killed seven including two officers.

articles.title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
articles.description: BBC News visits town where violence has escalated after the fatal crash and residents say they are living in fear.

articles.title: Reform promises to increase tax-free personal allowance to £15,000
articles.description: The party says the tax cut will be paid for by reducing public spending by £80bn.

articles.title: Disruption at Port of Dover as masked men hold protest
articles.description: Images appear to show hundreds of protesters, all dressed in black and wearing face coverings.
